advice_catalog.STANDARD_LOW: Standard frame + U-lock to a fixed rack is appropriate. Avoid blocking pedestrian paths.
advice_catalog.STANDARD_MEDIUM: Elevated lock-tampering rate. Secure both frame and rear wheel to an immovable street anchor.
advice_catalog.STANDARD_HIGH: Top-tier theft hotspot. Use two distinct lock mechanisms (U-lock + hardened chain) and avoid leaving past 20:00.
advice_catalog.EBIKE_HIGH: High-value target zone. Remove the battery and display unit, use a Sold Secure Gold/Diamond D-lock, and do not leave overnight.
